title: Less is More: Label-Guided Efficient Summarization of Procedural and Instructional Videos
abstract: arXiv:2601.12243v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Video summarization transforms long videos into concise representations that are easier to document and analyze, especially in high-stakes domains such as surgical training. However, long-form videos often require dense frame processing or supervised training pipelines, which can be computationally expensive and may still miss important procedural content. We present PRISM: Procedural Representation via Integrated Semantic and Multimodal Analysis, a zero-shot and training-free framework for frame-efficient procedural video summarization. PRISM selects fewer than 5% of video frames while retaining over 84% semantic content and improving over baselines by up to 7.5%. Rather than exhaustively processing frames, PRISM uses lightweight visual filtering and dynamically generated procedural labels as semantic anchors to select meaningful frame-label groups. translated_title: 少即是多：标签引导的程序性与教学视频高效摘要
translated_abstract: 视频摘要技术将长视频转化为更易于记录和分析的简洁表示，在手术培训等高风险领域尤为重要。然而，长视频通常需要密集的帧处理或有监督的训练流程，这不仅计算成本高昂，且仍可能遗漏重要的程序性内容。我们提出了PRISM（Procedural Representation via Integrated Semantic and Multimodal Analysis，基于语义与多模态集成分析的过程表示），一个零样本、无需训练的帧高效程序性视频摘要框架。PRISM仅选取不到5%的视频帧，同时保留超过84%的语义内容，相比基线方法提升高达7.5%。PRISM并非穷尽式地处理所有帧，而是利用轻量级视觉过滤和动态生成的程序性标签作为语义锚点，筛选出有意义的帧-标签组合。这种选择性推理设计保留了关键动作、过渡和上下文。
tldr: 提出零样本、无需训练的PRISM框架，以轻量级视觉过滤结合动态生成的程序性标签作为语义锚点，仅选取不到5%的视频帧即可保留超过84%的语义内容，实现高效的过程类视频摘要。
en_tdlr: PRISM is a zero-shot, training-free framework for procedural video summarization that leverages lightweight visual filtering and dynamically generated procedural labels as semantic anchors to select fewer than 5% of video frames while retaining over 84% of semantic content, improving over baselines by up to 7.5%.
